data.one_liner: Flutter client for Supabase providing auth, database, realtime, storage and edge functions.
data.what_it_does: It wraps Supabase's Dart SDK for Flutter, handling initialization, authentication flows, realtime subscriptions, storage access and edge function calls. It also offers utilities like deep linking and custom local storage.
use_when: You need a full‑stack backend with auth, database and realtime features in a Flutter app
You prefer Supabase over Firebase or other BaaS solutions
You want a single package to manage Supabase services across mobile, web and desktop
avoid_when: You only need a lightweight HTTP client without backend integration
You are using a different backend provider such as Firebase or a custom GraphQL server
strengths: Comprehensive Supabase integration (auth, db, realtime, storage)
Stream‑based auth state changes for reactive UI
weaknesses: Relies on Supabase ecosystem; not useful for other backends
Adds a layer of abstraction that may hide low‑level Supabase client details
Native sign‑in (Apple/Google) requires additional packages and platform setup
data.setup_notes: Add supabase_flutter to pubspec, call Supabase.initialize in main before runApp, configure platform-specific settings for native Apple/Google sign‑in, and optionally set up deep links and custom local storage.
